columns:
(1) So long as the CST holds any shares in the Company, the following matters shall require the
approval of not less than two (2) CST Directors:
(a) the appointment or removal of the Managing Director; and
(b) the issuance of new share capital.
(2) The following matters shall require the approval of not less than seventy-five per cent (75%)
of all the Directors for the time being in office and shall not require CST-specific approval:
(i) any change of name or brand of the Company;
(ii) any material change to the business plan of the Company; and
(iii) any employee restructuring or redundancy programme implemented within three (3) years
following the Initial Public Offering.
